answer.summary: Deterministic ArchUnit failure in TenantActiveTableAccessArchTest, not a flake: AtomicTestingService gains a direct AssetAgentJobRepository field and calls it from stop(), which the tenant-access rule does not allow. Re-running will fail the same way. AtomicTestingService.java is not in the touched-files list, so confirm the branch's stop() change is the source. The JSON parse stack trace at line 1244 is unrelated noise.
